---
title: "Summarise Tip Position"
---

```{r summary-setup, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_summary <- file.path(currentdir, "07_summary")
outdir_summary_tct <- file.path(outdir_summary, "01_tct_output")
if (!dir.exists(outdir_summary_tct)) {
    dir.create(outdir_summary_tct, recursive=T)
}
```

```{r}
# open metadata file
df_metadata <- readxl::read_xlsx(params$fn_eucs_metadata)

# extract df_metadata
df_metadata_tsv <- df_metadata %>% select(label, genus, subgenus, section)

fn_metadata_tsv <- file.path(outdir_summary, paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(params$fn_eucs_metadata)), ".tsv"))
data.table::fwrite(df_metadata_tsv, file=fn_metadata_tsv, sep="\t", quote=F)

# run taxonomic consistency test
rmarkdown::render(file.path(params$codedir, "TaxonomicConsistencyTest", "codes", "1_main.Rmd"), 
                  params=list(codedir           = file.path(params$codedir, "TaxonomicConsistencyTest"),
                              prefix            = "01_tct_output",
                              outdir            = outdir_summary,
                              thread            = params$thread,
                              redo              = params$redo,
                              dir_gene_tree     = outdir_locus_tree,
                              file_taxonomy_metadata    = fn_metadata_tsv,
                              file_list_tips    = "",
                              n_neighbour       = 5,
                              taxonomic_rank    = c("genus", "subgenus", "section")
                              ))
```
